name: truth-harness
description: Local-first evidence receipts for AI agents: exact computation, refutation, replay, and benchmark artifacts.

scripts.docker:check: docker compose run --rm truth-harness npm run check
scripts.docker:cli: docker compose run --rm truth-harness npm run cli --
scripts.docker:proof: docker compose run --rm truth-harness npm run proof:launch:engines
scripts.docker:demo: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js demo --require-symbolic-cross-check
scripts.demo:parity: npm run cli -- ask "for all integers n, n^2+n is even"
scripts.demo:cas: npm run cli -- cas check --operation simplify --expression "sin(x)^2 + cos(x)^2" --result 1 --fail-on-unverified
scripts.demo:sage: npm run cli -- cas check --backend sage --operation simplify --expression "sin(x)^2 + cos(x)^2" --result 1 --fail-on-unverified
scripts.demo:replay: npm run cli -- ask "for all integers n, n^2+n+1 is even" -- --out receipts/false-parity.json && npm run cli -- replay receipts/false-parity.json
scripts.demo:render: npm run cli -- render receipts/false-parity.json markdown receipts/false-parity.md && npm run cli -- render receipts/false-parity.json html receipts/false-parity.html
scripts.demo:smt: npm run cli -- smt check docs/examples/constraints.smt2 --fail-on-unverified
scripts.proof:lean-fixture: npm run cli -- proof project docs/examples/lean-fixture --json && npm run cli -- proof check docs/examples/lean-fixture/TruthHarnessFixture/Trivial.lean --timeout-ms 30000 --fail-on-unproved --json
scripts.proof:launch: npm run demo:replay && npm run demo:render && npm run demo:parity && npm run demo:bench && npm run demo:physics && npm run demo:numeric && npm run demo:symbolic && npm run demo:check
scripts.proof:launch:engines: npm run proof:launch && npm run demo:cas && npm run demo:smt
